learning_outcomes.text: Identify the critical parameters of a communication system based on its functionality specifications.
Define the subsystems that make up the complete system.
Specify functions and tasks of a subsystem for its integration into a communication system.
Define interfaces of the subsystems that integrate a communication system.
Propose interfaces of the subsystems that integrate a communication system.
Evaluate implementation alternatives for a communication subsystem.
Select a solution based on efficiency and cost criteria.
Integrate a communication system composed of different elements and subsystems.
Specify and execute test and verification plans for the complete system.

syllabus_topics: System and Systems Engineering. Phases of a complex project
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a practical work will be carried out during the course on the practical contents of the entire syllabus, where seven components will be evaluated, each with a specified weight. For the extraordinary call, there will be two parts: a theoretical exam covering all theoretical content (maximum 5 points) and the evaluation of practices through the elaboration and oral defense of a work (maximum 5 points). Differentiated evaluation follows the same guidelines as the extraordinary call.
